name: cavemio-task-progress
title: Task progress
description: For work that takes minutes: phases, a live timer, stats, cancel, and the result when it’s done.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The current phase and the outcome are announced politely; the bars, rolling digits and status line are decorative copies of that text.
- The timer ticks once a second and stops when the task settles or unmounts. Stats that are numbers roll; anything else renders as you pass it.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion nothing sweeps, fills or rolls; states change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: phases / phase
props.description: – · The stages and the index of the current one.

props.name: startedAt / duration
props.description: – · Start time for the live timer, or the total once known (ms).

props.name: stats
props.description: – · Live numbers, e.g. sources found and read.

props.name: message
props.description: – · A line while running, e.g. that it’s safe to leave.

props.name: onCancel / onOpen / openLabel
props.description: "Open result" · Cancel while running; open the result when done.

props.name: errorText / onRetry
props.description: – · Why it failed, and a Retry.

useCases.title: Deep research agents
useCases.description: Work that takes minutes, with a report at the end.

useCases.title: Builds, exports and batch jobs
useCases.description: A job with named stages and a time estimate people can see.

useCases.title: Imports and migrations
useCases.description: A long move of data that people can leave and come back to.

useCases.title: Report and media generation
useCases.description: AI-generated documents, images or video that take a while.

features.title: Phases that fill
features.description: Finished phases fill from the left and the current one sweeps.

features.title: A timer and live numbers
features.description: The elapsed time and your stats, such as sources found and read, roll as they change.

features.title: One status line
features.description: It names the phase and morphs from “Searching” to “Reading” to “Finished in 4m 12s” as a check draws.

features.title: One button for every state
features.description: Cancel while running becomes “Open report” when done, or Retry when it fails.

features.title: Failures say where
features.description: The failed phase fills red and the line reads “Stopped at reading”, with the reason opening in.

features.title: Safe to leave
features.description: A line can tell people they may close the tab. The current phase and the outcome are announced politely.

states.title: running
states.description: Finished phases fill from the left (620ms); the current one sweeps. The status line names the phase under a sweep of light and morphs as it moves on. Timer and numeric stats roll; the message and Cancel sit below.

states.title: done
states.description: The last bar fills, the message folds away, a check draws itself and the line morphs to "Finished in 4m 12s". Cancel turns blue and grows into "Open report →".

states.title: error
states.description: The failed phase fills red, the reason opens in, an alert swaps in and the line reads "Stopped at reading". The button morphs into Retry.

states.title: cancelled
states.description: "Cancelled after 1m 02s"; the button folds away and focus stays on the card.
